subject: Pointer error when submitting package to CRAN

messages.author: bebd85531a67ef86
messages.subject: Pointer error when submitting package to CRAN
parts:
Hi

I am attempting a CRAN submission of a minor revision to the help files (described in the ps below the main message) of the nimbleAPT package.  

My submissions are being rejected for what appears to be a pointer issue in nimbleEigenNimArr.h when building the vignette. The issue appears to be platform dependant.

The link to the CRAN check output is here - and includes the summary.txt file which reports the following

Package check result: OK Post-processing issues found: File: build_vignettes.log /home/hornik/tmp/CRAN_special_gcc-san/Library/nimble/include/nimble/nimbleEigenNimArr.h:244:11: runtime error: null pointer passed as argument 1, which is declared to never be null /home/hornik/tmp/CRAN_special_gcc-san/Library/nimble/include/nimble/nimbleEigenNimArr.h:244:11: runtime error: null pointer passed as argument 2, which is declared to never be null
  
All other checks appear to be OK

Windows: <https://win-builder.r-project.org/incoming_pretest/nimbleAPT_1.0.7_20250107_120848/Windows/00check.log>
Status: OK
Debian: <https://win-builder.r-project.org/incoming_pretest/nimbleAPT_1.0.7_20250107_120848/Debian/00check.log>
Status: OK

I've taken a look in nimbleEigenNimArr.h but feel rather out of my depth in there. Any ideas as to what the issue may be here?

Best wishes
David

ps: the main revision to my package was simply adding '[nimble]' to the links to various nimble functions in one the help files, i.e. changing this
@seealso \code{\link{configureMCMC}} \code{\link{addSampler}} \code{\link{buildMCMC}} \code{\link{buildAPT}} \code{\link{runMCMC}} 
to this
@seealso \code{\link[nimble]{configureMCMC}} \code{\link[nimble]{addSampler}} \code{\link[nimble]{buildMCMC}} \code{\link{buildAPT}} \code{\link[nimble]{runMCMC}} 
in nimbleAPT/R/APT_functions.R

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Pointer error when submitting package to CRAN
parts:
Hi David,

Thanks for the report. What a curious situation. C++ warnings and errors can be compiler- or OS-dependent, and that seems to be the case here. The error is coming from nimble-generated C++ while building your vignette, which explains why we don't see it when we submit new versions of nimble. From the path label "CRAN_special_gcc-san" in the CRAN output, it looks like it is running a sanitizer version of a C++ compiler, which would be instrumented to catch errors where a regular version might not, with the possibility of false positives. I somewhat doubt the error is a real problem because otherwise something would likely not be working, or could even be crashing. In any case, here are two possible work-arounds for you.

The error is coming from this line of your resizeVector method:

xPrev     = nimNumeric(length=lengthOri, value=x[1:lengthOri])

In this case, you should be able instead to do simply:

xPrev = x[1:lengthOri]

Assignment to the full object xPrev should allocate it as well as assign the values.

If that doesn't satisfy CRAN-checking, another option is this trick for getting vignette code run on your machine before submitting to CRAN, so all that happens on CRAN is building the vignette without running code.

Meanwhile I'll file an issue for us to look at what is happening and see if we can "fix" it (in quotes because it might not be broken but is nevertheless a potential pain for others).

Perry
